Geographies Served Programs Renewal Tales District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra “Renewal Tales”, a poignant and transformative initiative dedicated to the rescue and rehabilitation of stray animals and abandoned pets. This endeavour is not just a project; it's a narrative of renewal, compassion, and the unwavering belief that every life deserves a second chance. Bionic Care District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra “Bionic Care” is an initiative undertaken by us at Karma Foundation after understanding the urgent need for such services for stray animals in the city of Pune. Stray animals, living on the fringes of society, often face severe challenges, and among them, human-inflicted cruelty and vehicle accidents stand out as distressing issues. These vulnerable beings, lacking the protection and care afforded to domesticated animals, become victims of intentional harm and accidental injuries, leading to broken bones and fractures. Gentle Restoration District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra “Gentle Restoration”, is an empathetic response to the distinctive medical requirements of stray animals confronting a spectrum of soft tissue challenges. From tumours to wound closures and beyond, this initiative underscores our commitment to providing specialized and compassionate care, aiming to restore health and well-being to these vulnerable beings. Oncology Triumph District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra “Oncology Triumph” is an initiative by Karma Foundation, Pune, helping countless stray animals and helping them live a Cancer-free life. Cancer in animals, much like in humans, is characterized by the uncontrolled growth of abnormal cells that form tumours. These tumours can be benign or malignant. Malignant tumours have the potential to invade surrounding tissues and spread to other parts of the body, posing a serious threat to the affected animal's health. Cancer can affect various organs and systems in animals, including the skin, breast, bones, and internal organs. The causes of cancer in animals are multifactorial and may include genetic factors, environmental exposures, and age-related changes. Regardless of the specific type, cancer can significantly impact an animal's well-being, causing pain, discomfort, and a decline in overall health. Birth Guard Watch (Animal Birth Control Surgeries) District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra Birth Guard Watch, an initiative powered by Karma Foundation, is dedicated to collaborating with Animal Lovers, Feeders, and Citizens in a united effort to implement a comprehensive Trap Neuter Release (TNR) program. This community-led project not only focuses on humane sterilization and Rabies vaccination but also integrates a robust Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) reporting mechanism. This reporting system ensures transparency and accountability in sharing the progress of the program with CSR partners, involving the submission of monthly reports and photo documentation.
